body:
PR #142 now has a fresh independent non-Author re-review. **Archive requirements PASS; overall PASS WITH CONDITIONS.** All four original findings are addressed or documented; no new or residual Critical, High, Medium or Low archive finding was identified. Keep Draft. Inherited product failures and unexecuted assertions remain visible.

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base branch | `fix/adr0033-sdist-archive-hardening` |
| Reviewed/base HEAD | `59307c40ea65554736e131cedd00f04c9906551b` |
| Reviewed/base tree | `5ea93707d62b542c84632515392ac6a35c36cd65` |
| Head branch | `review/adr0033-hardening-rereview-20261023` |
| Published review HEAD | `ededcd83eb2d99a602ba18c8fe3c177125c825ac` |
| Published review tree | `2c721a0e8a58ebe8d1f795da821ea4e317b73e7e` |
| Review CI test merge | `d988fc0b9eda0fa60671da2ba691a3be978838ab` |

The test merge has exactly the base and published HEAD as parents, with the same effective tree. Remote branch, commit, PR identity and clean local worktree were verified. Only 102 new evidence files are added. Existing product, tests, scripts, workflows, ADRs, skills and frozen evidence are untouched. All 459 execution/configuration inputs match the reviewed source. No #139/#143 integration or automation changes occurred.

Independent archive audit: **66 standalone cases + 18 CLI outcomes pass**. All seven original attacks reject with exit 1 and failed receipts. Separate streamed 16/64 MiB PAX bombs stop at 8,922,625 bytes, with 64 KiB output chunks and zero TarInfo parsing calls. Integrated rejection occurs before extraction/rebuild/install. Initial reviewer expectation/setup failures are retained.

Fresh sdist: **677,902 bytes, 159 members, 5,921,698 regular-file bytes, 6,051,840 whole-tar bytes**. Direct/derived wheels are **762,725 bytes**; all 159 members, metadata and RECORD rows match. All 155 product inputs remain: 132 Python, 19 SQL, 2 JSON, 2 GraphQL. Backend-only rebuild has neither Git nor product installed. Separate outside-checkout venvs verify installed origins, all 155 hashes, CLI/resources/schema/integrity. Actual Python 3.12.14 / SQLite 3.53.1; no SQLite setup, replacement or matrix.

Actual local runs overlap:

- Broad: **3,058 PASS / 59 FAIL / 20 ERROR**, exit 1.
- Packaging: **151 PASS / 4 FAIL**, exit 1, including 131 archive tests.
- CI-focused: **266 PASS**; docs **8 PASS**; lint, format, SQLite policy and allowlisted placeholder docs build pass.
- Source I4/I5: **217/29 PASS**.
- Direct/sdist installed I4/I5: **246 PASS per artifact**. Additional independent collection/JUnit/journal runs also execute 246 per artifact with exact node/phase/finish/process reconciliation.
- Original Access smoke fails at its retained Transfer guard on both artifacts; installed orchestrator exits 1.

**3,544/5,888 unique ordinary source nodes executed; 2,344 ordinary + one live + one benchmark unrun.** No skips/xfails or full release qualification. Against the preserved #133 baseline, all 79 inherited unsuccessful nodes/phases/messages/refusals/path-function sequences match; zero added/resolved. Whole raw traceback bodies are 0/79 byte-identical because independently audited fixture representations and four packaging frame coordinates differ. Complete raw diffs remain; downstream assertions are unproved.

Frozen #142 hosted evidence was independently fetched, decoded and hash-bound:

- [Final tests 39892052621](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39892052621): **completed SUCCESS**, 21 payloads verified; runtime pytest 0, `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`. Evidence-only sdist gate skipped.
- [Final Access 39892052634](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39892052634): **completed FAILURE**, 102 payloads verified. Broad **3,058/59/20** across 3,137 nodes; focused **2,696/59/20** is wholly overlapping. **2,751/5,888 ordinary unrun**. Actual sdist gate and installed I4/I5 pass; original Access smokes fail.
- Both use test merge `e0c60765bd0d99b8276a8d0528dabfa7f4d6971a`, with exact base/head parents and reviewed tree. Final #142 has no Pages run; publication inputs/allowlist are unchanged.

**This review's final [Development CI 39900556951](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39900556951) completed SUCCESS.** Both offline and sqlite-policy jobs pass. All 21 receipt payload hashes, published feature SHA, actual test merge, tree and recomputed acceptance hash verify. Runtime pytest **0**, all 213 acceptance files unrun; sdist/installed lanes not applicable. `full_acceptance=false`, `acceptance_status=development_checks_passed`.

- Final conservative acceptance hash: `0756c5415c1ab8febeae852fbde984695426074c022eb568693ee2bbe09e36df`.
- Final CI receipt ZIP SHA-256: `a86338b24e01a689c717201d2ae0064f5de4534172032f5c8f1f87e017316315`.
- Frozen executable-input inventory hash: `c0742237299a23851496ed83d87f0f64ba75e41e1b64fa7f0e507861003d73f7`. Added evidence changes conservative acceptance hashing; no release-receipt transfer is claimed.
- Local raw ZIP: 173 payloads, SHA-256 `5972807d8a332478df9df43da17b0e6d9c63a74847e453b5d551ee8087469e50`.

[Full independent report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/ededcd83eb2d99a602ba18c8fe3c177125c825ac/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0033-hardening-rereview-20261023/REPORT.md), [findings](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/ededcd83eb2d99a602ba18c8fe3c177125c825ac/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0033-hardening-rereview-20261023/findings.json), [local evidence index](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/ededcd83eb2d99a602ba18c8fe3c177125c825ac/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0033-hardening-rereview-20261023/raw-evidence-index.json), [CI audit](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/ededcd83eb2d99a602ba18c8fe3c177125c825ac/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0033-hardening-rereview-20261023/ci/REPORT.md).

Repair ready for scoped acceptance/integration planning. Final combined-tree verification, separately authorized integration, inherited failures and full acceptance remain separate. No merge, release, deploy or automation modification. No action was denied, left pending approval or uncertain.
